summary: FINAL validation gate re-test (backend only) of the 6 iteration_7 fixes + full serial regression. New targeted suite /app/backend/tests/test_p01b45_fixes_i8.py (16 tests, 16/16 PASS) and the previously failing test in test_p01b45_settlement_makerchecker.py was STRENGTHENED (now asserts result=='no_action' AND internal_status stays SUBMITTED AND the correct provider still reaches SETTLED) and PASSES. FULL regression serially (pytest tests/ -n 0): 197 passed / 0 failed in 269s. (1) CRITICAL webhook provider scoping FIXED and verified: a mock_bank settlement (SUBMITTED, ref known) hit with 'settled'/'failed'/'cancelled'/'processing' webhooks on /api/webhooks/mock_processor -> every call 200 result='no_action', internal_status stayed SUBMITTED, external_status untouched, state history still exactly [PENDING, SUBMITTED]; the same ref on /api/webhooks/mock_bank -> 'applied:SETTLED'. Holds under TRUE concurrency: 16 barrier-synchronised webhooks (8 wrong provider / 8 right provider, distinct event_ids) -> 8x'no_action', exactly 1x'applied:SETTLED' + 7x'ignored_terminal', exactly 1 SETTLED history row. Unknown reference on the correct provider -> 'no_action'. (2) Payload conflict FIXED: same provider_event_id with a DIFFERENT body -> {'status':'duplicate_conflict'} with NO state change (settlement stayed PROCESSING, 1 inbox row, exactly 1 PROCESSING history row) and exactly 1 Financial.ProviderWebhookConflict event in outbox_events; identical duplicate still 'duplicate_ignored' with a single business effect. (3) Submit retry FIXED: after simulating the crash window (provider_reference forced to null while SUBMITTED) the retry returns 200 with a fresh mock_bank_ref_*/external_status=processing and does NOT append a duplicate state row; a normal second submit is still 409 INVALID_TRANSITION, and SETTLED-with-null-ref is still 409 INVALID_TRANSITION_FROM:SETTLED (no terminal bypass). (4) Recovery classification FIXED: an expired PENDING approval is counted and classified AUTO_RECOVERABLE, auto-heal flips it to EXPIRED (approvals_expired>=1), a second auto-heal returns 0 (idempotent), the expired approval can no longer be approved (409), and the next scan reports expired_approvals=0; an unprocessed webhook_inbox row is classified MANUAL_REVIEW and is NOT silently processed by auto-heal. (5) Precision honesty FIXED: dry_run=false -> 501 DESTRUCTIVE_MIGRATION_NOT_IMPLEMENTED (monetary_precision=PARTIAL), dry_run=true -> 200 representability report, non-admin -> 403. (6) Reject compensation FIXED: with fee_policy withdrawal flat=2, a 40 CC withdrawal debits 42 and reject refunds exactly 42 (balance back to start, status rejected); 10 barrier-synchronised rejects -> exactly 1x200 + 9x404 with exactly ONE refund tx (no double credit); injected refund fault (unpostable amount) -> 5xx, status REVERTED to pending with processed_at=null, balance untouched, and a recovery_journal entry kind='withdrawal_reject_refund_failed' classification='CRITICAL' written; after repairing the data the retry rejects AND refunds (recoverable, so a rejected withdrawal always refunds). No regression anywhere: all B1 (idempotency/kill-switch), B2 (holds double-spend/concurrency/burst/race), B3 (fees/refunds/reversals, admin decision atomicity, stress, guards, compensation), B4/B5 suites and backfill/drift tests green. Final invariants: ledger_balanced true, per_asset_sum JCC 0, jcc_supply_reconciled true, holds_health.healthy true, settlements.requires_review 0, outbox.dead_letter 0, severity INFO. Capability honesty verified exactly as specified (asset_registry/maker_checker/recovery_engine/reconciliation REAL; settlement_engine/outbox_events/monetary_precision PARTIAL; provider_adapters/card_issuing MOCK; payments_deposit_stripe SANDBOX; invest/crypto/fx PLANNED). No value creation/destruction, double-effect, double-settlement or maker-checker bypass found in this iteration.

minor.issue: A wrong-provider webhook whose provider_reference DOES exist under another provider returns the same 'no_action' as a totally unknown reference and emits no security signal. The spoof attempt is invisible to operators (webhook_inbox row is marked PROCESSED, so recovery scan will not flag it). Suggest emitting Financial.ProviderScopeViolation / opening a reconciliation case when the reference matches a settlement of a different provider.

duplicate_conflict is only signalled via the outbox event: the stored inbox row keeps processing_status=PROCESSED and no reconciliation case / REQUIRES_REVIEW is opened, so a provider sending contradictory bodies for the same event_id needs log archaeology to be noticed.

The retry path calls provider.submit() again and overwrites provider_reference with a NEW reference. Safe with the MOCK adapter, but against a real provider the first (possibly successful) submission would be orphaned and the payout could be sent twice. Before provider_adapters leaves MOCK, submit must pass a stable idempotency key (e.g. settlement_id) to the provider and keep/compare the previous reference.
outbox_events/outbox_consumed still grow unbounded (1324 DELIVERED rows in the preview DB) — ACCEPTED/known gap, re-stated for completeness only.

action_items: OPTIONAL (pre-production, not blocking v1 freeze): emit a security event / open a case when a webhook's provider_reference belongs to a different provider, instead of the silent 'no_action'.
OPTIONAL: surface duplicate_conflict to operators (inbox flag or reconciliation case), not only as an outbox event.
MUST-DO before provider_adapters leaves MOCK: pass a stable provider-side idempotency key on settlement submit so the retry path cannot cause a double payout.
Still outstanding from iterations 5/6/7: split server.py (2356 lines) into routers.
critical_code_review_comments: provider_webhook now resolves the settlement with find_one({'provider_reference': ref, 'provider': provider}) — the cross-provider spoof path is closed and verified under 16-way concurrency; the payload_hash comparison on DuplicateKeyError correctly separates a benign retry from a contradictory replay.

submit_settlement's retry guard (status=='SUBMITTED' and not provider_reference) is narrow enough not to weaken the state machine (terminal states still 409), but it re-invokes the provider without an idempotency key — the only remaining double-effect risk in the settlement path, currently masked by the MOCK adapter.

admin_reject_wd's try/except compensation reverts the pending->rejected flip and writes a CRITICAL recovery_journal entry; verified end-to-end with an injected posting fault (status back to pending, balance untouched, retry refunds) — the 'a rejected withdrawal must always refund' invariant now holds.

recovery_scan's dead 'pass' loop is gone; expired_approvals -> AUTO_RECOVERABLE and unprocessed_inbox -> MANUAL_REVIEW, and auto-heal's update_many on PENDING+expired is naturally idempotent (second run modifies 0).
precision_migrate raising 501 for dry_run=false is the honest behaviour for monetary_precision=PARTIAL; the dry-run representability report is unchanged.

success_rate.backend: 100% (197/197 serial full regression; new fix suite 16/16; previously failing cross-provider webhook test now PASSES with stricter assertions)

All removed in fixture teardown. Post-run verification: 0 TEST users/sessions/txs/withdrawals/holds/ledger entries/webhook rows, 0 settlements, 0 pending approvals, 0 PROCESSING idempotency records, 0 dead-letter outbox, fee_policy reset to {}. One orphan reconciliation_case (rc_52f166217a, its settlement was deleted by the tracker teardown) was removed manually; reconciliation_open_cases is now 0 and financial-health severity INFO.
test_credentials: Emergent Google auth; tests seed user+session directly in Mongo (Authorization: Bearer <session_token>) per /app/memory/test_credentials.md. Maker-checker needs TWO distinct is_admin users (conftest._mk_user with is_admin=True twice).
context_for_next_testing_agent: Financial Core v1 is green: run `cd /app/backend && pytest tests/ -n 0` (~270s, 197 tests) as the regression gate — the suites mutate the GLOBAL settings.fee_policy and admin integrity endpoints, so NEVER run them with xdist. New file test_p01b45_fixes_i8.py covers the 6 iteration_7 fixes; test_p01b45_settlement_makerchecker.py::test_cross_provider_webhook_scope now asserts result=='no_action' + SUBMITTED + correct-provider SETTLED (do not weaken). Injected-fault trick for the reject compensation path: insert a pending withdrawal with a non-numeric amount_cc so add_transaction raises before any posting. Deleting settlements in teardown can orphan reconciliation_cases -> check reconciliation_open_cases after a run and clean orphans, otherwise financial-health severity goes non-INFO for the next agent. Known ACCEPTED gaps (do not re-report as blockers): no webhook HMAC while provider_adapters=MOCK, unbounded outbox tables, destructive precision migration not implemented (501).
rca_of_the_issue: N/A — all six iteration_7 findings are confirmed fixed at the source: the webhook lookup is now provider-scoped (cross-provider spoof closed, verified concurrently), the inbox compares payload_hash, submit has a narrow crash-window retry, recovery classifies+heals expired approvals, precision migrate is honest (501), and reject wraps the refund in compensation with a CRITICAL journal entry. The only residual (non-blocking, MOCK-masked) risk is that the submit retry generates a new provider_reference without a provider-side idempotency key.
